clips.title: The story
paras: Silverwing Outpost guards the eastern bank of the Falfarren River in south-central Ashenvale. Duriel Moonfire commands the garrison, the Alliance's easternmost hold against the Horde in the contested woodland.

Silverwing Outpost lies southwest of Splintertree Post and just north of the Barrens border. Its place on the eastern bank of the Falfarren River puts it in territory the Horde contests and patrols. From here, the garrison shields night elf holdings deeper in the forest. Duriel Moonfire and her Silverwing Sentinels face constant attacks from nearby orcs seeking to drive night elf forces from the area.
